variants.name: mint-forest
variants.scene: A misty mint woodland clearing. Bottles on a broad grey mossy rock; one white echinacea flower lies beside the amber bottle, a natural fern at the base. Soft diffuse morning light from upper left, airy quiet background. Classic balanced composition, beautiful but restrained.

variants.name: fern-stream
variants.scene: A calm fern grove near a barely visible woodland stream, bottles on a flat dry stone with very sparse moss. Pale mint water bokeh in far distance, one small white echinacea and a few fern fronds low on the sides. Soft overcast natural daylight; no clutter or dramatic splashes.

variants.name: sage-garden

A white coneflower and a delicate fern in the lower-right foreground, dappled light extremely soft and subtle. Open natural atmosphere and rich believable textures.

variants.name: soft-morning
